'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Stephen Cellucci LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Cellucci]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Day 2 Light is the same as the Day 1 Plead My Case To The Senate list.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Nolimit
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
